newsitem.title: CHINA: China produces 21 mln tonnes fertilisers Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: China produces 21 mln tonnes fertilisers Jan-Oct.

text.p: China produced 21.29 million tonnes of fertilisers in the first 10 months of this year, an increase of 10 percent over the same 1995 period, the official Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

Production had already accounted for 89.1 percent of the state-set target for 1996, but selling the fertiliser was proving difficult and stockpiles were growing, the agency quoted a Ministry of Chemical Industry report as saying.
October fertiliser output was 2.17 million tonnes, up 6.7 percent from the same period of 1995, it said.
Unsold stocks had soared to 20.68 million tonnes, up 46 percent year-on-year, with nitrogen and phosphate fertilisers accounting for most of the stockpiled products, it said.
Output of pesticides between January and October had reached 302,000 tonnes, a year-on-year increase of 25.8 percent and 131.3 percent of the target for the year, it said.
Pesticide production in October was 18,000 tonnes, down 2.2 percent, it said but gave no other details.
